title: First run: Welcome's Start or a connected cloud while the record cannot be read counts as a full record and finishes, so the questions never come back once the record reads
evidence: Done: fixed by this PR. From the owner's review of PR 1602. ios/HealthRoadmap/App/RootView.swift worked out needs from needsFlow, which is false when store.myData is nil, so an unread record looked full: S34's welcome x started(false) finished, set onboarded, and a relaunch with a readable record that lacks height opened on the tabs with no questions. Base (before S34) left onboarded false for Start; only Connected finished on base. A plain needs: myData == nil || needsQuestions guard would not have worked: with myData nil the questions case finishes at once (OnboardingView.begin sends began(nil) on an unreadable record, and the Color.clear arm with no Apple Health does the same), so it still set onboarded. Fix: Cover's started and connected carry needs: Bool?, nil while myData is nil; welcome x started(nil) and welcome x connected(nil) go to none with no effect, so welcomed is set, onboarded stays false and the next launch decides again. Trade-off accepted for this rare case: that session's saves do not count toward the backup offer until the next launch (S34's old behaviour). Pins: FirstRunTests table rows for both nil events, the persisted keys after started(nil), and Start while unread then a relaunch with a record lacking height decides questions. US-57 AC9, US-54
